Here’s why you should ALWAYS lynch on day 1 . Now, while this will usually end up with a vanillatownie down, this is incredibly useful. First off, the prospect of a lynch fuels discussion to a great degree. When there’s an actual vote happening, it’s a motivator to talk and for discussion to be more productive , while people usually don’t care much about no lynch days. Also, the flip on the player lynched is incredibly useful down the line . We can deduce scum based on their behaviour relative to the flip and using vote reading, which is impossible without lynching someone. Something else to be considered is that town is playing against the clock . If scum aren’t dead by a certain point, they lose . Therefore, they must take the most advantage of their time , which would involve lynching for the reasons listed above. To note is that although scum will usually not be lynched D1, it can happen, and if it does, town basically wins the game right there. Lynching leads to the best outcomes .
